{"response":{"candidates":[{"index":0,"content":{"role":"model","parts":[{"text":"\u003ccode\u003e\nbool kissat_restarting (kissat *solver) {\n  assert (solver-\u003eunassigned);\n  if (!GET_OPTION (restart))\n    return false;\n  if (!solver-\u003elevel)\n    return false;\n\n  // Stable mode uses Reluctant Doubling strategy (standard Kissat behavior)\n  if (solver-\u003estable)\n    return kissat_reluctant_triggered (&solver-\u003ereluctant);\n\n  // Step 1: Retrieve Fast and Slow EMAs of LBD (Literal Block Distance)\n  const double fast = AVERAGE (fast_glue);\n  const double slow = AVERAGE (slow_glue);\n\n  // Step 2: Compute the trend ratio R = Fast_EMA / Slow_EMA\n  double R = 1.0;\n  if (slow \u003e 0.0)\n    R = fast / slow;\n\n  // Step 3: Determine dynamic multiplier M based on trend\n  double M = 1.0;\n  if (R \u003c 0.85)\n    M = 1.4; // Search improving, extend run\n  else if (R \u003e 1.15)\n    M = 0.7; // Search degrading, curtail run\n\n  // Step 4: Retrieve scheduled restart conflict limit\n  const uint64_t limit = solver-\u003elimits.restart.conflicts;\n\n  // Check if current conflicts exceed the scheduled limit multiplied by M\n  // We cast the result to uint64_t for comparison with CONFLICTS\n  if (CONFLICTS \u003c (uint64_t) (limit * M))\n    return false;\n\n  // Step 5: Secondary 'Blocking' check (Trail Protection)\n  // Compare current trail size against running average trail size\n  const double avg_trail = AVERAGE (trail);\n  \n  // Only perform check if we have valid statistics (!QUIET) and average is positive\n  if (avg_trail \u003e 0.0) {\n    const unsigned current_trail = SIZE_STACK (solver-\u003etrail);\n    \n    // Trigger restart only if current trail is not significantly higher than average\n    // Threshold: current \u003c 1.25 * average\n    if (current_trail \u003e= 1.25 * avg_trail) {\n      kissat_extremely_verbose (solver,\n                                \"restart blocked by trail protection: \"\n                                \"current %u \u003e= 1.25 * avg %.2f\",\n                                current_trail, avg_trail);\n      return false;\n    }\n  }\n\n  kissat_extremely_verbose (solver,\n                            \"restart triggered: R=%.2f M=%.2f \"\n                            \"conflicts=%\" PRIu64 \" limit=%\" PRIu64,\n                            R, M, CONFLICTS, limit);\n\n  return true;\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e","thoughtSignature":""}]},"finishReason":"STOP"}],"responseId":"cNWKaYrGHLHnqtsPpMDm-QQ","usageMetadata":{"candidatesTokenCount":627,"promptTokensDetails":[{"tokenCount":5886,"modality":"TEXT"}],"totalTokenCount":13277,"thoughtsTokenCount":6764,"promptTokenCount":5886},"modelVersion":"gemini-3-pro-preview"},"model":"models/gemini-3-pro-preview","key":"req-0001"}
